info.title: hypha
info.description:
Fetches the upstream OMG SysML v2 / KerML sources and the Systems Modeling API, generates a local
      knowledge base from them – metamodel, textual notation, model library, specification text and
      cross-references – and looks names up in it, with JSON output for editors and language-model
      tools.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: hypha - fetch the upstream OMG SysML v2 / KerML sources and generate the knowledge base

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

options.name: --version
options.description: Show version information

options.name: --repository-root
options.description: The folder holding sources/ and knowledge/. Discovered by walking up from the working directory when omitted.

options.name: --toolchain-cache-root
options.description: Keep the managed toolchain - the uv executable, uv's package cache and the Python it installs - under this folder. Without it, uv is cached in the per-user application data folder and uv uses its own default locations.

options.name: --token
options.description: A GitHub token. Falls back to GITHUB_TOKEN / GH_TOKEN. Optional - every read is public - but the anonymous API allows only 60 requests an hour.

options.name: --log-level
options.description: Verbose, Debug, Information, Warning, Error or Fatal. [default: Information]

options.name: --no-logo
options.description: Suppress the banner. [default: False]

commands.name: discover
commands.description: List the upstream releases hypha can be generated for

options.name: --limit
options.description: How many releases to list, newest first. 0 lists them all. [default: 10]

commands.name: fetch
commands.description: Download a release's inputs into sources/ and record it

options.name: --tag
options.description: The release tag to fetch, e.g. 2026-05.

options.name: --no-specs
options.description: Skip the OMG specification PDFs. Downloaded by default, since a fully local install needs everything - they are copyright OMG, land in a git-ignored folder and must never be committed. [default: False]

options.name: --force
options.description: Download every file again, rather than resuming and keeping what is there. [default: False]

options.name: --no-default
options.description: Leave the existing default release alone rather than switching to this one. [default: False]

commands.name: generate
commands.description: Generate the knowledge base from the fetched sources

options.name: --tag
options.description: The release to generate for; repeatable. Every installed release when omitted.

options.name: --output
options.description: Write the generated artifacts here instead of into the repository. Inputs are still read from the repository.

arguments.name: ARTIFACT
arguments.description: The artifact to generate, e.g. metamodel or cross-references. Every artifact, in dependency order, when omitted.

commands.name: list
commands.description: List the installed releases, the default, and what has been generated

options.name: --json
options.description: Print one line of JSON instead of a table - for editors and scripts. [default: False]

commands.name: lookup
commands.description: Print the generated page of a metamodel element or model-library declaration

options.name: --kind
options.description: metamodel or model-library.

options.name: --name
options.description: A short or qualified name, e.g. PartUsage, Real or ScalarValues::Real.

options.name: --tag
options.description: The installed release to answer from. The default release when omitted.

options.name: --start-line
options.description: The first line to print, 1-based. Defaults to the declaration for a model-library name and to the top of the page for a metamodel name.

options.name: --max-lines
options.description: How many lines to print, at most 2000. [default: 160]

options.name: --json
options.description: Print one line of JSON - for editors, language-model tools and scripts. [default: False]

commands.name: move-window
commands.description: Fetch, regenerate and verify a release, then evict the releases that fall outside the window

options.name: --tag
options.description: The release to move the window to, e.g. 2026-06.

options.name: --keep
options.description: How many releases the window holds; older ones are evicted. [default: 2]

commands.name: use
commands.description: Switch which installed release the plugin answers from by default

options.name: --tag
options.description: The installed release to answer from by default.

commands.name: remove
commands.description: Remove one installed release's sources and knowledge

options.name: --tag
options.description: The installed release to remove.

options.name: --force
options.description: Remove the release even if it is the only one installed. [default: False]

commands.name: check
commands.description: Compare installed releases against what is offerable upstream

options.name: --json
options.description: Print one line of JSON instead of a table - for scripts and the hook. [default: False]
